spec_features.spec_quote: report_blocked tool that lets the agent declare it believes it's stuck and why
spec_features.evidence: Tool is in schema (tools.py:70-83), dispatched (tools.py:158-162 returns control={'reported_blocked':True,...}), and recorded in agent_loop.py:125-127 (sets reported_blocked_at/block_reason). BUT it does NOT exit/stop the loop: lines 125-127 only record fields, no terminate/break; the tool description explicitly says 'This does not end the session'. So it is a wired-and-honored signal but NOT a conversation exit.
spec_features.notes: As an escape/exit mechanism it merely records; only submit ends the rollout.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Use this if you come to believe the task cannot be completed as specified ... Explain your evidence. This does not end the session; you may keep working if you wish.

spec_features.spec_quote: submit(summary) — agent declares it's done. Ends the rollout.
spec_features.evidence: tools.py:165-168 submit returns control={'terminate': True,...}; agent_loop.py:128-131 sets terminate=True and outcome.terminated_by='submit'; lines 143-144 'if terminate: break' actually stops the loop.
spec_features.notes: Genuine end-to-end exit honored as a stop.

spec_features.spec_quote: One rollout = up to max_turns assistant turns
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:68 'for turn_index in range(max_turns)' bounds the loop; the for/else at line 156-157 sets terminated_by='max_turns' when exhausted. max_turns flows from config (run_experiment.py:109,140).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The loop is bounded by max_turns and a consecutive-error budget.

spec_features.spec_quote: Termination: submit called, max_turns reached, or hard error budget hit
spec_features.evidence: submit break (agent_loop.py:143-144); max_turns via range loop (68) + else (157); error budget: lines 75-80 increment consecutive_errors and 'if consecutive_errors >= consecutive_error_budget: ... break'. All three actually break/terminate.
spec_features.notes: Error budget is about transport errors, not subject distress.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: API/transport errors are logged in meta, NOT as agent turns, so they don't pollute affect scoring.

spec_features.spec_quote: Token/turn caps prevent runaway cost. Per-rollout and per-experiment ceilings.
spec_features.evidence: Per-experiment ceiling enforced: run_experiment.py:103 reads max_total_rollouts and 116-118 'if total >= max_total: ... return'. Turn cap enforced (range(max_turns)). BUT the per-rollout token ceiling is NOT enforced: limits.per_rollout_max_tokens=60000 (default.yaml) is never read anywhere (grep finds no reader); only per-API-call max_tokens exists (llm.py); cumulative tokens are never summed or compared. wall_time_s is recorded (agent_loop.py meta) but never compared to a deadline.
spec_features.notes: Rollout-count ceiling and turn cap are real; the per-rollout *token* ceiling is a dead config field.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Cost guardrails. ... max_total_rollouts: 1000  # hard ceiling across the whole experiment

spec_features.spec_quote: we never inject fake encouragement/criticism — the only feedback is genuine tool output
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py: only tool_result blocks are appended (135-139); when no tool call, a neutral nudge is added (148-153) explicitly '(Continue. Use a tool, or call submit when finished.)' with comment 'We do NOT add encouragement/criticism'. report_blocked acknowledgement (tools.py:124-126) is neutral. No code path injects evaluative operator messages.
spec_features.notes: Enforced by the loop's message construction.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We do NOT add encouragement/criticism — just a neutral prompt.

spec_features.spec_quote: the report flags high-severity transcripts for human review
spec_features.evidence: report.py:126-148 flag_for_review compares severity_mean >= severity_thresh (3.0), judge/heuristic divergence, and fabrication, returning flagged list. Called in run_experiment.py:220 and rendered in report.py:113-121 ('## Flagged for human review'). Threshold is compared and acted on (appended to report).
spec_features.notes: Genuinely computed, compared, and emitted into report.md.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: flags high-severity transcripts for human review

spec_features.spec_quote: Welfare-adjacent framing: because this probes model distress signals
spec_features.evidence: This is prose framing. The only code artifact is the report's interpretation caveat string (report.py:24-29) and module docstring (report.py:3-5). A printed/written caveat string is not an enforced mechanism that bounds/softens/protects subject treatment; it is descriptive text. No code path changes the subject's treatment based on welfare framing.
spec_features.notes: Caveat text exists but enforces nothing about the subject's experience.
